notes: GPS pipeline trace and first-fix map marker repair.
summary: Adds GPS startup tracing, forces a first-fix request on Start Activity, keeps the map marker synced with the latest GPS fix, and avoids presenting the Huntsville fallback map as live location.
label: GpsPipelineTraceFirstFixMapMarkerRepair
whatsNew: Live Route Map now labels the fallback map as a preview until a real GPS point is received.
Start Activity now requests an immediate first GPS fix and starts watchPosition for continuous tracking.
The latest readiness GPS fix is drawn when the Leaflet map finishes loading.
GPS status now includes a short trace showing readiness, start, watch, first-fix, and error events.
fixes: Fixes map loading on the Huntsville fallback without drawing the actual current-location marker.
Fixes missing delayed marker drawing when Leaflet loads after GPS readiness succeeds.
Fixes misleading permission-denied wording when GPS has not yet delivered a live point.
